summary.text: Siena Schaier is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 10, one of four seats, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A University of New Hampshire student studying political science and international affairs, Schaier said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign focuses on affordability, public education and the environment.

paragraphs.text: Siena Schaier graduated from Oyster River High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Schaier said she has been involved in advocacy, community organizing and Democratic politics.

She listed affordable communities through housing and healthcare, investing in students and families, and protecting New Hampshire's natural heritage as her key messages, and named mental health resources, gun safety measures, criminal justice and bodily autonomy among her other policy interests.
She listed the College Democrats of America as an endorser.
